verdict.rationale: Proton Pass ships an official CLI for retrieving secrets and items in scripts and CI/CD pipelines, including viewing password items. The product also generates TOTP codes for saved logins. However, no evidence shows the CLI outputting a current TOTP code, so an agent may need to pull the stored secret and compute the code with an external tool. Missing for 10: explicit CLI/API command returning a live TOTP code, documentation of TOTP fields in CLI item output, a programmatic API beyond the CLI, hands-on corroboration of an agent completing 2FA via the CLI.
